title: Renewal Rate by Included Alignments — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
On the renewal of an expired Alignment Services & Plans month-based plan, a renewal-rate reduction takes a percentage of the line's plan price off the renewal price. The percentage is set by the number of alignments the expired plan recorded as included in the plan over its term (the purchase-day alignment included):

| Included alignments the expired plan recorded over its term | Renewal-rate reduction, as a percentage of the plan price |
|---|---|
| at least 5 | 15% |
| at least 3 but fewer than 5 | 10% |
| fewer than 3 | 0% |

The reduction is worked out on its own, as a percentage of the plan price, and taken off the renewal price, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

### Cases (hypothetical expired plans, plan price 200.00 for the illustration)
| Included alignments | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 5 | 15%: 30.00 |
| 4 | 10%: 20.00 |
| 2 | none |

Alignments charged at the member early price and readjustments are not included alignments and do not count.
